AddRuleV4.title: Create Rule (New Quality Inspection)
AddRuleV4.requestParamsDescription:
## Sample request parameters

```json
{
  "rules": [
    {
      "name": "siqi-test",
      "comments": "Create a test rule",
      "autoReview": 1,
      "level": 2,
      "type": 1,
      "business": [
        {
          "bid": 0,
          "name": "All businesses"
        }
      ],
      "fullCycle": 1,
      "targetType": 10,
      "scoreNumType": 0,
      "scoreType": 1,
      "scoreNum": "1",
      "lambda": "a",
      "triggers": [
        "a"
      ],
      "ruleScoreType": 3,
      "isHitNumScore": 0
    }
  ],
  "conditions": [
    {
      "cid": "a",
      "lambda": "1",
      "check_range": {},
      "operators": [
        {
          "oid": "1",
          "type": "HIT_ANY_KEYWORDS",
          "param": {
            "contextChatMatch": false,
            "in_sentence": false,
            "keywordMatchSize": 1,
            "keywords": [
              "Hello",
              "Welcome"
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Sample request code

```java
public class sca {

    private static String ak = "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY_ID";
    private static String sk = "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET";

    private static void addRule() throws Exception {
        String json="{\n" +
                "  \"rules\": [\n" +
                "    {\n" +
                "      \"name\": \"siqi-test\",\n" +
                "      \"comments\": \"Create a test rule\",\n" +
                "      \"autoReview\": 1,\n" +
                "      \"level\": 2,\n" +
                "      \"type\": 1,\n" +
                "      \"business\": [\n" +
                "        {\n" +
                "          \"bid\": 0,\n" +
                "          \"name\": \"All businesses\"\n" +
                "        }\n" +
                "      ],\n" +
                "      \"fullCycle\": 1,\n" +
                "      \"targetType\": 10,\n" +
                "      \"scoreNumType\": 0,\n" +
                "      \"scoreType\": 1,\n" +
                "      \"scoreNum\": \"1\",\n" +
                "      \"lambda\": \"a\",\n" +
                "      \"triggers\": [\n" +
                "        \"a\"\n" +
                "      ],\n" +
                "      \"ruleScoreType\": 3,\n" +
                "      \"isHitNumScore\": 0\n" +
                "    }\n" +
                "  ],\n" +
                "  \"conditions\": [\n" +
                "    {\n" +
                "      \"cid\": \"a\",\n" +
                "      \"lambda\": \"1\",\n" +
                "      \"check_range\": {},\n" +
                "      \"operators\": [\n" +
                "        {\n" +
                "          \"oid\": \"1\",\n" +
                "          \"type\": \"HIT_ANY_KEYWORDS\",\n" +
                "          \"param\": {\n" +
                "            \"contextChatMatch\": false,\n" +
                "            \"in_sentence\": false,\n" +
                "            \"keywordMatchSize\": 1,\n" +
                "            \"keywords\": [\n" +
                "              \"Hello\",\n" +
                "              \"Welcome\"\n" +
                "            ]\n" +
                "          }\n" +
                "        }\n" +
                "      ]\n" +
                "    }\n" +
                "  ]\n" +
                "}";


        Config config = new Config();
        config.setAccessKeyId(ak).setAccessKeySecret(sk)
                .setEndpoint("qualitycheck.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com")
                .setRegionId("cn-hangzhou").setProtocol("HTTPS");

        Client client = new Client(config);
        AddRuleV4Request result = new AddRuleV4Request();

        result.setJsonStrForRule(json);

        AddRuleV4Response response = client.addRuleV4(result);
        System.out.println(JSONObject.toJSONString(response));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        addRule();
    }
}
```

**Description of jsonStr properties:**

| Property | Value Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| tid | string | Yes | The unique identifier (UUID) of the current conversation. Ensure its uniqueness. It can be understood as the call ID in your own operational system. The backend uses this identifier to merge segments into a complete conversation. The length must be at least 8 characters, and the first 8 characters must represent the date (YYYYMMDD) when the call occurred. For example, if the recording was made on July 5, 2020, the prefix should be 20200705. We recommend appending your own operational system’s call ID after this prefix, such as 20200705-234890134. The timestamp in the prefix must fall within one month before to one hour after the API call time. |
| business | string | No | Line-of-business name. This is custom data used for categorization and statistics. |
| callType | integer | No | Call type. Valid values: 1 (outbound, default); 3 (inbound); 4 (other). |
| callee | string | No | Called number. For outbound calls, this refers to the customer's number; for inbound calls, it refers to the agent's number. |
| caller | string | No | Calling number. For outbound calls, this refers to the agent's number; for inbound calls, it refers to the customer's number. |
| skillGroupId | long | No | Skill group ID. |
| skillGroupName | string | No | Skill group name. |
| schemeTaskConfigId | integer | No | Job ID. |

GetNextResultToVerify.title: Obtain details of the next file for manual validation
GetNextResultToVerify.summary: Retrieve the next file details for manual verification.
GetNextResultToVerify.requestParamsDescription:
### Request Parameter JSON String Information

| Property   | Value type | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| :--------- | :--------- | :------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| taskId     | String     | Yes      | The ID of the precision comparison task. This is `precisions.taskId` in the return value of the `ListPrecisionTask` API.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| pageNumber | Integer    | No       | The current page number. The next data entry on the current page is returned. If empty, the first unverified data entry for the task is returned. For subsequent calls, get the `index` value from the previous `GetNextResultToVerify` return. For example, if you pass 1, the second data entry is returned. If you pass -1, the first data entry is returned. |
| pageSize   | Integer    | No       | Always pass 1.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| original   | Integer    | No       | Whether to return the original (correct) text. Valid values: 0 (No), 1 (Yes). Default is 0.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| fileName   | String     | No       | The file name. If not specified, it is equivalent to clicking 'Next'. If specified, the result for this file is returned.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
GetNextResultToVerify.responseParamsDescription:
## Response Parameters

| Property       | Value type | Required | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| :------------- | :--------- | :------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| status         | Integer    | Yes      | File status. 0 or 1 indicates not completed; 2 or 3 indicates completed.                                                                             |
| audioURL       | String     | No       | The audio URL, excluding http/https.                                                                                                                 |
| audioScheme    | String     | No       | The protocol of the audio URL. Possible values: http, https.                                                                                         |
| fileName       | String     | No       | File name.                                                                                                                                           |
| fileId         | String     | Yes      | File ID.                                                                                                                                             |
| verified       | Boolean    | Yes      | Indicates whether manual verification has been performed. Possible values: `false`: Not yet verified; `true`: Already verified.                      |
| dialogues      | List       | No       | Dialogue data. This field has a value when `status` is 2 or 3. For details, see the Dialogue data description below.                                 |
| totalCount     | Integer    | Yes      | The total number of files for this task.                                                                                                             |
| verifiedCount  | Integer    | Yes      | The total number of verified files.                                                                                                                  |
| incorrectWords | Integer    | Yes      | The number of incorrect words in the transcription.                                                                                                  |
| precision      | Float      | Yes      | Current recognition accuracy.                                                                                                                        |
| updateTime     | String     | Yes      | Last update time.                                                                                                                                    |
| duration       | Integer    | Yes      | The total duration of files in the current task, in seconds.                                                                                         |
| index          | Integer    | Yes      | The index of the current file. The frontend passes this value when retrieving the next entry. It starts from 1, so the first entry has a value of 1. |

### Dialogue Data Description

| Property       | Value type | Required | Description                                                                                                                      |
| :------------- | :--------- | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| begin          | Long       | Yes      | The offset of this sentence's start time relative to the overall dialogue start time, in milliseconds.                           |
| beginTime      | Long       | Yes      | The start time of this sentence.                                                                                                 |
| end            | Long       | Yes      | The offset of this sentence's end time relative to the overall dialogue start time, in milliseconds.                             |
| hourMinSec     | String     | Yes      | The start time of this sentence in HH:mm:ss format.                                                                              |
| role           | String     | Yes      | The speaker's role.                                                                                                              |
| sourceRole     | String     | No       | The correct role.                                                                                                                |
| identity       | String     | Yes      | Role ARN.                                                                                                                        |
| words          | String     | Yes      | The transcribed content of this sentence.                                                                                        |
| sourceWords    | String     | No       | The correct content of this sentence. This is returned only after the sentence has been verified.                                |
| delta          | List       | No       | Errors in the text. For details, see the Delta properties description below.                                                     |
| incorrectWords | Integer    | No       | The number of incorrect words in the transcription of this sentence. This is returned only after the sentence has been verified. |

### Delta Properties Description

| Property | Value type | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| :------- | :--------- | :------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| source   | Chunk      | Yes      | The correct dialogue content after manual verification. For details, see the Chunk properties description below. |
| target   | Chunk      | Yes      | The transcribed dialogue content. For details, see the Chunk properties description below.                       |
| type     | String     | Yes      | The type of error. Possible values: CHANGE: Error, INSERT: Extra word, DELETE: Missing word.                     |

### Chunk Properties Description

| Property | Value type | Required | Description               |
| :------- | :--------- | :------- | :------------------------ |
| line     | List       | Yes      | The specific word.        |
| position | Integer    | Yes      | The position of the word. |

```java

import com.alibaba.fastjson.JSONObject;
import com.aliyun.qualitycheck20190115.Client;
import com.aliyun.qualitycheck20190115.models.*;
import com.aliyun.teaopenapi.models.Config;


public class sca {

    private static String ak = "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY_ID";
    private static String sk = "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET";

    private static void getResult() throws Exception {
        Config config = new Config();
        config.setAccessKeyId(ak).setAccessKeySecret(sk)
                .setEndpoint("qualitycheck.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com")
                .setRegionId("cn-hangzhou").setProtocol("HTTPS");
        Client client = new Client(config);
        String json = "{\"excludeFields\":\"recording.url,finalHitRuleIds,hitResult.lambda,hitResult.schemeId,hitResult.schemeVersion,hitResult.targetType,hitResult.hits,hitResult.level,hitResult.taskFlowId\",\"requiredFields\":\"agent,status,errorMessage,reviewStatus,reviewResult,score,taskId,reviewer,resolver,recording.name,recording.duration,hitResult,business,assignmentTime,recording.jsonParamStr\",\"schemeTaskConfigId\":4878,\"pageNumber\":1,\"pageSize\":10,\"startTime\":\"2024-12-22 00:00:00\",\"endTime\":\"2025-01-20 17:27:19\",\"sourceDataTypeList\":[1]}";
        GetResultRequest request = new GetResultRequest();
        request.setJsonStr(json);
        GetResultResponse response = client.getResult(request);
        System.out.println(JSONObject.toJSONString(response));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        getResult();
    }
}
```

schema.description: A complete JSON string. See the details below for the exact format.

Code.description: The result code. **200** means success. Any other value means failure. Use this field to identify the cause of failure.

Message.description: The error message if the request fails. If the request succeeds, the value is **successful**.

Success.description:
Indicates whether the request succeeded. Use this field to check the result:

- **true** means success.

- false or **null** means failure.

PageSize.description: The number of items per page.

OperLambda.description: The logical relationship between operators in the condition.

OperatorBasicInfo.description: The operators included in the condition.

Type.description: The operator type.

Param.description: The specific expression for the operator.

DifferentRole.description: Used only for time-interval operators. If true, sentences spoken by the same role as the current sentence are excluded from the calculation.

Regex.description: The regular expression used for regular-expression operators.

TargetRole.description: Used only for duplicate-sentence operators. If the current sentence matches this regular expression, the matched part is searched for in the sentence before the current one, specified by the target\_role value.

VelocityInMint.description: The words-per-minute threshold used for speech-rate checks. The system compares the current sentence's rate against this value.

Average.description: The speech-rate check mode. Possible values: true checks the average rate across the entire conversation. false checks the rate of the current sentence only.

KeywordExtension.description: For keyword-check operators, enables synonym expansion.

Score.description: The similarity score used for text-similarity operators.

NotRegex.description: The regular expression to exclude in regex checks.

CompareOperator.description: The comparison operator. Possible values: gt (greater than) and lt (less than). Default is gt.

DelayTime.description: The delay time used for interruption checks. For example, if set to 1000, an overlap is considered an interruption only if it occurs more than 1000 milliseconds after the other speaker starts. Unit: milliseconds.

KeywordMatchSize.description: The number of keywords to match for keyword-check operators. The meaning depends on the detection type: 1 means match any one keyword. -1 means match all keywords. A positive integer N means match any N keywords. 0 means match none. The default value depends on the keyword detection type (type): HIT\_ANY\_KEYWORDS uses 1. INCLUDE\_KEYWORDS uses -1.

HitTime.description: For context-duplicate operators, the number of times a sentence must repeat before it counts as a violation. Default is 1.

BeginType.description: Used only for abnormal-hangup operators. Always pass DIALOGUE.

Target.description: The number of previous sentences to check. If 0, the time interval equals the current sentence's end time minus its start time.

MaxEmotionChangeValue.description: The energy value used for energy-detection operators. Valid range: 1–10.

Threshold.description: The threshold used for edit-distance and matching-score operators.

From.description: For context-duplicate operators, the maximum number of sentences between duplicates before it counts as a violation. Default is 2, meaning a duplicate within the last two sentences (inclusive) triggers a violation.

FromEnd.description: For time-interval operators, determines whether the interval is calculated as the current sentence's end time minus the target sentence's end time.

MinWordSize.description: The minimum number of words in a sentence before speech-rate checking begins.

InSentence.description: Specifies whether to check the full sentence or just part of it.

Phrase.description: The reference sentence used for minimum-edit-distance operators.

Similarity_threshold.description: This field is deprecated. Ignore it.

CheckType.description: The detection method used for energy checks. Possible values: 1 (energy fluctuation between adjacent sentences), 2 (maximum energy span), and 3 (energy range detection). Default is 3.

Interval.description: The time interval used for time-interval operators.

ContextChatMatch.description: For keyword-check operators, enables multi-sentence analysis. Possible values: true for multi-sentence analysis. false for single-sentence analysis. Default is false. See the detailed explanation below.

Excludes.description: The list of exception sentences for context-duplicate operators.

items.description: The list of exception sentences for context-duplicate operators. Repeats of these sentences do not count as violations. Default is empty.

AntModelInfo.description: This field is deprecated. Ignore it.

items.description: This field is deprecated. Ignore it.

Pvalues.description: This field is deprecated. Ignore it.

items.description: This field is deprecated. Ignore it.
The specific expression for similarity-matching operators.
items.example: [“优惠力度特别大”,”特别的优惠”]

SimilarlySentence.description: The collection of example sentences for text-similarity operators.

items.description: The collection of example sentences for text-similarity operators.
items.example: [“优惠力度特别大”,”特别的优惠”]

Role.description: The role for which the condition applies.

Anchor.description: The anchor relationship for the condition.

HitTime.description: `1~N` means the first (Nth) time the condition hits. **-1** means the last time it hits.

Location.description:
- **CURRENT**: the current sentence where the condition hits.

- **BEFORE**: before the sentence where the condition hits.

- **AFTER**: after the sentence where the condition hits.

AnchorCid.description: The condition ID used to identify the anchor condition.

Range.description: The range defined by both Role and Anchor. `1~N` means the first (Nth) sentence within that range. -1 means the last sentence within that range.

To.description: `1~N` means the first (Nth) sentence within the range defined by anchor and role. **-1** means the last sentence within that range.

From.description: `1~N` means the first (Nth) sentence within the range defined by anchor and role. **-1** means the last sentence within that range.

RuleLambda.description: The logical relationship between conditions in the rule.

BusinessCategoryBasicInfo.description: The business categories associated with the rule.

items.description: The business categories associated with the rule.

BusinessName.description: The name of the business category associated with the rule.

Bid.description: The business ID (BID) associated with the rule. Must be numeric.

items.description: The condition IDs whose content should be returned when the rule triggers. When you set a rule ID, the response includes the specific content that triggered the rule.

GetRuleDetail.title: Obtain Detail Information of a Rule
GetRuleDetail.summary: Retrieves the detailed information of a rule.
GetRuleDetail.description: > This operation is used in conjunction with [Get basic rule information](~~142333~~). First, call the GetRule operation to obtain the rule ID. Then, use the rule ID as a parameter to call the **GetRuleDetail** operation.
GetRuleDetail.requestParamsDescription:
**Request parameters in JSON string format**

| Property             | Type           | Required | Description                                                                   |
| :------------------- | :------------- | :------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ruleIds              | `List<String>` | No       | The rule ID. If you specify this parameter, all other parameters are ignored. |
| businessCategoryName | `List<String>` | No       | The business category name.                                                   |

Success.description: Indicates whether the request succeeded. Set to true for success. Set to false or null for failure.

Code.description: Result code. A value of **200** indicates success. Other values indicate failure. Use this field to identify the cause of failure.

Message.description: Error details if the request failed. Returns **successful** if the request succeeded.

Messages.description: Error details if the request failed. Use this field when returning multiple messages.

items.description: Error details if the request failed. Use this field when returning multiple messages.

HttpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the request. A value of 200 indicates success.

GetSyncResult.title: Obtain real-time quality inspection results
GetSyncResult.summary: You can obtain the real-time quality inspection result of the hotline.
GetSyncResult.requestParamsDescription:
**Request Parameters JSON String Information**
| Property            | Value Type | Required | Description                                                                                                                         |
| :------------------ | :--------- | :------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| taskId              | String     | No       | Use the **task ID returned after uploading quality inspection data** to query. Generally, you must specify either taskId or tid, or use a time range for the query. Therefore, one of taskId, tid, or startTime/endTime is required. |
| tid                 | String     | No       | Unique identifier of a conversation, such as the unique identifier of a recording. Generally, you must specify either tid or a time range for the query. Therefore, one of taskId, tid, or startTime/endTime is required. |
| startTime           | String     | No       | **Start Time** of the interval for querying by task upload time (API call time), in the format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'.               |
| endTime             | String     | No       | **End Time** of the interval for querying by task upload time (API call time), in the format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'.                 |
| pageSize            | Integer    | No       | Number of data entries returned per page. Must be greater than 0 and less than 100. Default value: 10.                              |
| pageNumber          | Integer    | No       | Page number of the data to return. Default value: 1.                                                                                |
| countTotal          | Boolean    | No       | Whether to return the total number of entries in the paginated data. Default value: true. When the data volume is large, disabling this option improves API response speed. |
| requiredFields      | String     | No       | Fields to include in the return result. Separate multiple fields with commas. Select fields as needed. Optional fields: taskId (Job ID), score (Score), status (Status), recording (File Information), recording.dataSet (Dataset Name), asrResult (Transcription Result), hitResult (Quality Inspection Result), comments (Review Comments), agent (Agent Information). Default value: score,status,taskId,hitResult,reviewHistory |
| excludeFields       | String     | No       | Fields to exclude from the return result, typically sub-fields. Separate multiple fields with commas. Example value: hitResult.hits. |
| ruleIds             | List       | No       | List of rule IDs that were hit. Filters data that matches the specified rules.                                                       |
| customerServiceName | String     | No       | Customer service representative name.                                                                                               |
| customerServiceId   | String     | No       | Customer service representative ID.                                                                                                 |
| caller              | String     | No       | Calling number.                                                                                                                     |
| callee              | String     | No       | Called number.                                                                                                                      |
| callId              | String     | No       | Call ID.                                                                                                                            |
| skillGroupName      | String     | No       | Skill group name.                                                                                                                   |
| hitStatus           | Integer    | No       | Hit status. Valid values: 0 (No rule hit); 1 (Rule hit).                                                                            |
| reviewStatus        | Integer    | No       | Review status. Valid values: 0 (Not reviewed); 1 (Reviewed).                                                                        |
| assignStatus        | Integer    | No       | File assignment status. Valid values: 0 (Not assigned); 1 (Assigned).                                                                |
| scoreType           | Integer    | No       | Filter type when filtering by quality inspection score. **Must be used together with totalScore.** Valid values: 1 (Return data where the quality inspection score equals totalScore); 2 (Return data where the quality inspection score is less than totalScore); 3 (Return data where the quality inspection score is greater than totalScore). |
| reviewer            | Long       | No       | Quality inspector ID. Returns only files assigned to this inspector.                                                                |
| totalScore          | Integer    | No       | Quality inspection score value for filtering. **Must be used together with scoreType.**                                              |
| durationType        | Integer    | No       | Filter type when filtering by recording duration. **Must be used together with duration.** Valid values: 1 (Return data where the recording duration equals duration); 2 (Return data where the recording duration is less than duration); 3 (Return data where the recording duration is greater than duration). |
| duration            | Integer    | No       | Recording duration for filtering, in seconds. **Must be used together with durationType.**                                           |
| fileName            | String     | No       | File name. You must provide the complete file name. Fuzzy search is not supported.                                                   |
| remark1             | String     | No       | Custom data 1, provided when invoking the **SyncQualityCheck.json** API to upload quality inspection data.                           |
| remark2             | String     | No       | Custom data 2, provided when invoking the **SyncQualityCheck.json** API to upload quality inspection data.                           |
| remark3             | String     | No       | Custom data 3, provided when invoking the **SyncQualityCheck.json** API to upload quality inspection data.                           |
| sortField           | String     | No       | Parameter used for sorting. Currently, only quality inspection score and custom data fields (remark1/remark2/remark3) support sorting. Valid values: score/remark1/remark2/remark3. |
| sortType            | String     | No       | Sorting rule. Valid values: desc (Descending); asc (Ascending).                                                                     |

SaveConfigDataSet.summary: Saves the speaker role configuration for a dataset.
SaveConfigDataSet.requestParamsDescription:
### JSON String for Request Parameters

| Property       | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                |
| :------------- | :------ | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| setId          | Long    | Yes      | The ID of the dataset.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| channelType    | Integer | Yes      | The audio file type. Valid values: 1 (mono) or 2 (stereo).                                                                                                                                 |
| jsonStrForRule | String  | No       | A JSON-formatted rule. Required for mono files. For stereo files, this rule determines which channel is the agent channel. For more information, see the jsonStrForRule description below. |
| channelId0     | Integer | No       | Required for stereo files. The channel number for the agent. Valid values: 0 or 1. For example, if the agent is on channel 0, set this value to 0.                                         |
| channelId1     | Integer | No       | Required for stereo files. The channel number for the customer. Valid values: 0 or 1. For example, if the customer is on channel 1, set this value to 1.                                   |

## jsonStrForRule Description

The jsonStrForRule field defines a quality inspection rule. This rule contains only one keyword-matching condition. Use the fixed format shown below. You can only change the keywords array.

```
{"conditions":[{"cid":"1","check_range":{},"lambda":"1","operators":[{"oid":1,"type":"HIT_ANY_KEYWORDS","param":{"keywords":["what can I help you with","customer service center"],"in_sentence":false}}]}],"rules":[{"externalProperty":0,"lambda":"1","rid":"1"}],"roleJudgeMethod":"keyword"}
```

SyncQualityCheck.title: SyncQualityCheck
SyncQualityCheck.summary: Perform real-time quality inspection for hotlines.
SyncQualityCheck.description:
Real-time hotline quality inspection transcribes spoken dialogue into text during a call. It sends the text to the Smart Conversation Analysis system for real-time quality inspection to detect potential issues or risks. You can display the dialogue text and inspection results in real time on the customer service representative's workbench (a third-party system). This differs from offline quality inspection, which uses UploadAudioData for inspection or dataset inspection. For details, see the developer guide. Offline quality inspection occurs after the call ends and the recording file is generated.

**Usage Flow**

You can implement real-time transcription of audio streams to text during calls, or use Alibaba Cloud Call Center (CC) directly. CC integrates deeply with Smart Conversation Analysis, enabling real-time quality inspection during calls without API integration.

If you implement audio-to-text conversion yourself, invoke the SyncQualityCheck API for real-time quality inspection after a speaker finishes a sentence and generates dialogue text. This returns the inspection result for that sentence synchronously.

You should include skill group information when uploading data. Then, you can use the Call Center Quality Inspection - Configuration Management feature to configure different quality inspection rules for calls from different skill groups.

After the call ends, you can store the recording file on a storage server accessible over the public network. You can invoke the recording information maintenance API: UpdateSyncQualityCheckData. You can submit the recording name, recording file URL, and other details to the Smart Conversation Analysis service. This lets quality inspectors play back the recording during review.

After the call ends, you can view the quality inspection results in Call Center Quality Inspection - Result Display - Real-time Quality Inspection Results. You can also invoke the real-time quality inspection result query API: GetSyncResult to retrieve the results. You can use Score Dashboard - Real-time Dashboard to view data charts for customer service representatives, skill groups, and scoring items.

**Full-Text Quality Inspection**

Quality inspection rules include dozens of operators. Some operators require dialogue context (multi-turn conversations between customer service representatives and customers) for analysis. However, real-time quality inspection occurs during a call and typically uses text from only one sentence spoken by a single speaker. Some operators are not suitable for real-time quality inspection. Therefore, quality inspection rules are divided into real-time quality inspection rules and full-text quality inspection rules:

**Real-time quality inspection rules**: Rules used for real-time quality inspection. They support a limited number of operator types. They do not support specifying the detection range for operators.

**Full-text quality inspection rules**: Rules used for offline quality inspection. They support all operator types. They support custom detection ranges for operators.

For calls that underwent real-time quality inspection, you can apply full-text quality inspection rules to the complete dialogue text after the call ends. To enable full-text quality inspection after real-time inspection, see the full-text quality inspection description in Call Center Quality Inspection - Configuration Management.

The backend merges a complete conversation based on this ID. The length must be at least 8 characters, with the first 8 characters representing the call's date (YYYYMMDD). For example, if the recording date is July 5, 2020, the prefix is 20200705. Append your business system's call ID after the prefix, such as 20200705-234890134.                 "  \"callId\": \"job-548734733657395200\",\n" +
```java
                "  \"customerName\": \"Zhang San Voice 11\",\n" +

        Config config = new Config();
        config.setAccessKeyId(ak).setAccessKeySecret(sk)
                .setEndpoint("qualitycheck.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com")
```

SyncQualityCheck.responseParamsDescription: **Dialogue Context Sentence Description**: In complex scenarios, a single sentence from a speaker might not be enough to detect violations. Previous sentences are often needed as context for quality inspection analysis. The current maximum number of context sentences is 30 by default. For example, in a call where the 40th sentence has been spoken, after uploading the 40th sentence, we retrieve the preceding 29 sentences. This creates a total of 30 sentences, including the latest 40th sentence, for quality inspection analysis. Therefore, in extreme cases, some sentences undergo quality inspection analysis 30 times. When returning quality inspection results, we automatically deduplicate them. This means if a sentence hits the same condition within the same rule multiple times, only the first hit result for that sentence is returned.

UpdateAsrVocab.title: Update Hotword Group
UpdateAsrVocab.requestParamsDescription:
**JSON string details**

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                 |
| :-------- | :----- | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| vocabId   | String | Yes      | The ID of the hotword vocabulary.                                                           |
| words     | List   | Yes      | A list of hotwords. For more information, see the description of the words parameter below. |
| name      | String | No       | The name of the hotword vocabulary.                                                         |

**Details of the words parameter**

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| :-------- | :------ | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| word      | String  | Yes      | The hotword.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| weight    | Integer | No       | The weight of the hotword. The default value is 2. The value must be an integer from -6 to 5. A positive weight increases the recognition probability. A negative weight decreases the recognition probability. A weight of -6 prevents the word from being recognized. A weight of 2 is a common setting. If the recognition is not effective, increase the weight. However, a large weight may reduce the recognition accuracy of other words. |
UpdateAsrVocab.extraInfo:
### Sample invocation
```
UpdateAsrVocabRequest UpdateAsrVocabRequest = new UpdateAsrVocabRequest();
UpdateAsrVocabRequest.setAcceptFormat(FormatType.JSON);
String dataJsonStr = "{
" +
""vocabId":"yourVocabId","+
""customWords":{" +
     ""New Custom 2":2,"+
     ""New Custom 1":1"+
"},"+
""strenWords":["+
     ""New Strengthened","+
     ""New Enhanced""+
"],"+
""weakWords":["+
     ""New Weakened","+
     ""New Reduced""+
"]"+
"}";
UpdateAsrVocabRequest.setJsonStr(dataJsonStr);
UpdateAsrVocabResponse response = client.getAcsResponse(UpdateAsrVocabRequest);
```

UploadAudioData.title: UploadAudioData
UploadAudioData.summary:
Uploads offline audio data—such as recorded call session files—for quality inspection. This operation supports two call center agent scenarios.
Scenario 1: Native integration with Alibaba Cloud Call Center (CC). No development is required. You can push call data to Smart Conversation Analysis (SCA) with a single click.
Scenario 2: Integration with your own call center system. Each time a recording is generated, the call center pushes it to SCA for analysis.
UploadAudioData.description:
### Process description

The process is as follows: An API call uploads the audio file for quality inspection → The audio file is converted to text → The transcribed text is separated by speaker role (agent and customer), based on the specified channel separation method → The role-separated text is analyzed using quality inspection rules → Quality inspection completes.

### Task execution efficiency

Task execution speed depends on how quickly the audio file is transcribed. A 5-minute audio file is typically transcribed in about 2 minutes. However, if the transcription service queue is long, a waiting period occurs. Transcription usually completes within 6 hours, except when large volumes of data are uploaded simultaneously—more than 500 hours of audio within 30 minutes. After transcription, quality inspection analysis completes in milliseconds.

### Audio file URL requirements

- Supports single-channel or dual-channel audio files in WAV or MP3 format. File size must be less than 512 MB.

- The URL must be accessible over HTTP. Local files are not supported. The audio file must have public access permissions.

- The URL must use a domain name, not an IP address. The URL cannot contain spaces or Chinese characters.

- After transcription, the system deletes the downloaded audio file. No copy of the recording is retained.

- If your audio URL has an expiration period—such as a presigned URL for an audio file stored in Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS)—set the validity period to at least 12 hours. Ideally, set it to 24 hours. Because transcription may involve queuing, the audio file is downloaded only when transcription begins. A longer validity period prevents the URL from expiring before download starts.

- After quality inspection completes, the provided URL is used for playback when you review the file in the console. Ensure the URL remains valid long-term. Otherwise, audio playback fails.

### Role separation

After transcription, the system automatically separates the text into two speaker roles but cannot determine which role corresponds to the agent and which to the customer. You must define rules for role separation. Role separation accuracy is critical because many quality inspection rules apply to a specific role—for example, checking only agent or only customer utterances. Incorrect role separation significantly reduces quality inspection accuracy.

Audio files are typically either single-channel (mono) or dual-channel (stereo):

- Single-channel recording: The voices of the agent and customer are mixed on one channel. After transcription, the system uses a built-in algorithm to separate dialogue into two roles. You can provide a list of keywords commonly spoken by agents. The system analyzes the transcribed text sentence by sentence. When a sentence contains a keyword, that speaker is identified as the agent, and the other speaker is identified as the customer. For more information, see the recognizeRoleDataSetId and serviceChannelKeywords request parameters. Because conversations can be unpredictable—for example, speakers may talk over each other—role separation for single-channel recordings cannot achieve 100% accuracy. We strongly recommend saving recordings as dual-channel audio.

- Dual-channel recording: The voices of the agent and customer are stored on separate channels. Even if speakers talk over each other, transcription accurately distinguishes between them. Specify the agent and customer channels using the serviceChannel and clientChannel request parameters.

### Retrieve quality inspection results

Because audio analysis is asynchronous, you must retrieve results asynchronously. You can retrieve results in one of the following three ways:

- Message notification: For more information, see [Message Queue](~~213237~~). After you receive a message, call the GetResult operation to retrieve detailed results. (Recommended)

- Callback: Specify a callbackUrl in the request parameters. The system initiates a callback after the task completes. After you receive the callback, call the GetResult operation to retrieve detailed results.

- Polling: The operation returns a task ID (taskId). Use the taskId to poll the getResult operation and retrieve the result asynchronously. Check the `status` parameter in the response to determine whether the task is complete. We recommend a polling interval of 30 seconds or longer because analysis typically completes within a few minutes. (Not recommended)

## Callback parameters

Assume the webhook address you provide is `http://aliyun.com/callback`. The full callback URL will be `http://aliyun.com/callback?taskId=xxx&timestamp=xxx&aliUid=xxx&signature=xxx&event=xxx`, where:

- taskId: The task ID.

- timestamp: The timestamp of the call, in milliseconds.

- aliUid: The UID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

- signature: The signature. You can use this to verify that the request originates from Alibaba Cloud. Calculation method: Encrypt the string taskId=xxx\&timestamp=xxx\&aliUid=xxx using MD5 and Base64. Parameter order matters. After receiving the callback, extract taskId and timestamp from the callback URL. Your aliUid is your Alibaba Cloud account ID. Compare your calculated signature with the `signature` in the URL to verify the request. For more information, see the Java code sample below.

- event: The event name. Use this to identify which event triggered the callback. The value is TaskComplete, indicating a callback upon task completion.

```java
public static void signature() {
    long timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
    String taskId = "xxx";
    String aliUid = "xxx";
    // Encrypt taskId=xxx&timestamp=xxx&aliUid=xxx using MD5 and Base64, and place the result in the signature field.
    String signature;
    try {
        signature = URLEncoder.encode(md5Base64("taskId=" + taskId + "&timestamp=" + timestamp + "&aliUid=" + aliUid), "utf-8");
        System.out.println(signature);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        e.printStackTrace();
    }
}

public static String md5Base64(String str) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException {
    // The string must be UTF-8 encoded.
    byte[] utfBytes = str.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    MessageDigest mdTemp = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");
    mdTemp.update(utfBytes);
    byte[] md5Bytes = mdTemp.digest();
    return Base64.encodeBase64String(md5Bytes);
}
```

UploadData.title: UploadData
UploadData.description:
You can call UploadData.json to upload text-based quality inspection data. Text typically originates from online customer service interactions or tickets. The API returns a task ID. You can retrieve results in one of three ways:

- Message notification: For details, see [message queues](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213237.html). After you receive a message, call the GetResult API to retrieve detailed results. (Recommended)

- Callback: Specify a callback URL in your request parameters. After the task completes, the system sends a callback to that URL. Then call the GetResult API to retrieve detailed results.

- Polling: Use the returned task ID to poll the GetResult API asynchronously. Check whether the status field in the response indicates completion. (Not recommended)

## Emoji display notes

On the review details page, only standard Emoji characters display. When uploading, replace emojis with UTF-8 character codes such as \😀. For example, the smiley face emoji is \😀. Codes start with \&# and end with a semicolon. For more information, see the [Emoji character reference table](https://www.runoob.com/charsets/ref-emoji.html) and the [HTML character display guide](https://www.runoob.com/charsets/ref-html-symbols.html).

## Callback parameter description

If you specify the callback URL `http://aliyun.com/callback`, the full callback URL becomes `http://aliyun.com/callback?taskId=xxx&timestamp=xxx&signature=xxx&event=xxx`. Parameters:

- taskId: Task ID.

- timestamp: UNIX timestamp of the callback request. Unit: milliseconds.

- aliUid: Alibaba Cloud account UID of the caller.

- signature: Signature used to verify the request originated from Alibaba Cloud. Compute it by applying MD5 then Base64 encoding to the string `taskId=xxx&timestamp=xxx&aliUid=xxx`. Maintain the parameter order. After receiving the callback, extract taskId and timestamp from the URL. Use your Alibaba Cloud account UID as aliUid. Compare your computed signature with the one in the URL. See the Java code example below.

- event: Event name. Use this to identify which event triggered the callback. Valid value: TaskComplete (sent when the task completes).

```
public static void signature() {
    long timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
    String taskId = "xxxx";
    String aliUid = "xxxxx";
    // Apply MD5 then Base64 encoding to "taskId=xxx&timestamp=xxx&aliUid=xxx", and place result in the signature field
    String signature;
    try {
        signature = URLEncoder.encode(md5Base64("taskId=" + taskId + "&timestamp=" + timestamp + "&aliUid=" + aliUid), "utf-8");
        System.out.println(signature);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        e.printStackTrace();
    }
}

public static String md5Base64(String str) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException {
    // String encoding must be UTF-8
    byte[] utfBytes = str.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    MessageDigest mdTemp = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");
    mdTemp.update(utfBytes);
    byte[] md5Bytes = mdTemp.digest();
    return Base64.encodeBase64String(md5Bytes);
}
```

To.description: The ending character position (exclusive) for highlighting the keyword. The maximum value is the total number of characters in the sentence minus 1. For example, in the sentence “Impossible to give you a refund,” if from=0 and to=3, the highlighted keyword is “Impossible” (the first three characters).

Pid.description: Index of this sentence in the full list of sentences. This is the index of the sentence in the dialogue array in the request parameter. Index starts at 0.

UploadDataV4.title: UploadDataV4
UploadDataV4.description:
You can call the UploadData.json operation to upload text data for quality inspection. The text usually comes from sources such as online customer service and tickets. The API returns a task ID. You can retrieve the results in one of the following three ways:

- Message notifications: After you receive a notification, call the GetResult API to obtain the detailed results. For more information, see [Message Queue](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213237.html). (Recommended)

- Callbacks: Specify a callbackUrl in the request parameters. The system automatically initiates a callback after the task is complete. After you receive the callback, call the GetResult API to retrieve the detailed results.

- Polling: Use the task ID returned by this API to poll the GetResult API and asynchronously retrieve the results. Check the status in the response to determine whether the task is complete. (Not recommended)

## Emoji display instructions

When you view conversation details on the review details page, only standard emojis can be displayed. When you upload data, you must replace emojis with their UTF-8 character codes. For example, the code for a smiley face is `😀`. The code must start with \&# and end with a semicolon (;). For more information, see [Emoji Character Set Reference](https://www.runoob.com/charsets/ref-emoji.html) and [HTML Symbol Reference](https://www.runoob.com/charsets/ref-html-symbols.html).

## Callback parameters

If the webhook address that you provide is `http://aliyun.com/callback`, the full callback URL is `http://aliyun.com/callback?taskId=xxx&timestamp=xxx&signature=xxx&event=xxx`. The parameters are described as follows:

- taskId: The task ID.

- timestamp: The UNIX timestamp of the call, in milliseconds.

- aliUid: The UID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

- signature: The signature that is used to verify that the request is from Alibaba Cloud. To calculate the signature, encrypt the string `taskId=xxx&timestamp=xxx&aliUid=xxx` using MD5 and Base64. The order of the parameters is important. After you receive the callback, retrieve the taskId and timestamp from the callback URL. The aliUid is the UID of your Alibaba Cloud account. To verify the request, compare your calculated signature with the signature in the URL. For more information, see the Java code example below.

- event: The event name. This parameter is used to determine which event triggered the callback. The value is TaskComplete, which indicates that the task is complete.

```
public static void signature() {
    long timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
    String taskId = "xxxx";
    String aliUid = "xxxxx";
    // Encrypt the string "taskId=xxx&timestamp=xxx&aliUid=xxx" using MD5 and Base64, and put the result in the signature field.
    String signature;
    try {
        signature = URLEncoder.encode(md5Base64("taskId=" + taskId + "&timestamp=" + timestamp + "&aliUid=" + aliUid), "utf-8");
        System.out.println(signature);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        e.printStackTrace();
    }
}

public static String md5Base64(String str) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException {
    // The string must be UTF-8 encoded.
    byte[] utfBytes = str.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    MessageDigest mdTemp = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");
    mdTemp.update(utfBytes);
    byte[] md5Bytes = mdTemp.digest();
    return Base64.encodeBase64String(md5Bytes);
}
```

### Param: Operator types and parameters

The param object contains many properties. Some are shared across all operator types, while others apply only to specific types. This section lists each operator type, its valid properties, and provides configuration examples.

### 1. Keyword check

Matches if any keyword is present (HIT\_ANY\_KEYWORDS), all keywords are present, a specific number of keywords are present, or no keywords are present (INCLUDE\_KEYWORDS).

| Property         | Type    | Required | Example value                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| :--------------- | :------ | :------- | :------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| keywords         | List    | Yes      | \["Hello", "Hi", "Good morning"] | List of keywords.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| contextChatMatch | Boolean | No       | false                            | Whether to analyze multiple sentences together. Valid values: true (multi-sentence analysis), false (single-sentence analysis). Default: false. See **Detailed analysis modes**                                                                        |
| keywordMatchSize | Integer | No       | 3                                | Number of keywords to match. Rules:Any one keyword: set to 1.All keywords: set to -1.Any N keywords: set to an integer between 1 and the total number of keywords.None: set to 0.Default depends on type: HIT_ANY_KEYWORDS → 1, INCLUDE_KEYWORDS → -1. |
| in_sentence      | Boolean | No       | true                             | Whether to restrict matching to a single sentence. A sentence ends at punctuation like commas or periods. Valid values: true (restrict), false (no restriction). Default: false. This setting has no effect if contextChatMatch is true.               |
| keywordExtension | Integer | No       | 0                                | Whether to enable synonym expansion. Valid values: 1 (enable), 0 (disable). Default: 0.                                                                                                                                                                |

**Detailed analysis modes**

- Single-sentence and multi-sentence analysis apply to the sentences that are defined by the role, anchor, and range of the current condition.

- Limited sentences: Refers to one or more sentences that are defined by the role, anchor, and range of the condition.

- Single-sentence analysis: Analyzes each limited sentence separately. For example, to match all keywords, at least one sentence must contain all of the specified keywords.

- Multi-sentence analysis: Combines all limited sentences into a single paragraph and analyzes it. For example, to match all keywords, the combined paragraph must contain all of the specified keywords.

**Request examples:** 1. Single-sentence analysis to match any one keyword.

```
{
    "keywords":[
        "Hi",
        "Hello",
        "Good morning"
    ],
    "contextChatMatch":false
}
```

```
}
```

```
        "Good morning"

}
```

## Range usage notes

The \`range\` parameter uses a numeric interval to select the sentences to which the condition applies.

### Without a prerequisite condition

![](https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1l.utJ1L2gK0jSZFmXXc7iXXa-1534-486.png)

1\. {"from":1,"to":3}: Selects the first three sentences spoken by the specified role. 2. {"from":-1,"to":-3}: Selects the last three sentences spoken by the specified role. 3. {"from":3,"to":-3}: Selects from the third sentence to the third-to-last sentence spoken by the specified role.

### With a prerequisite condition

If a prerequisite condition exists, the system uses the matched prerequisite sentence as a divider to split all sentences into three segments: • All sentences before the matched prerequisite sentence. • All sentences after the matched prerequisite sentence. • Sentences around the matched prerequisite sentence. First, you must choose a segment. Then, you can use a numeric interval to select specific sentences within that segment.

![](https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1zZWuJ1L2gK0jSZFmXXc7iXXa-1462-544.png)

**Before the prerequisite match (anchor.location = BEFORE)**

![](https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1MO8fXZ4z2K4jSZKPXXXAYpXa-1486-636.png)

1\. {"from":1,"to":3}: The first three sentences in the selected segment. The sentence immediately before the prerequisite match is considered sentence 1. 2. {"from":-1,"to":-3}: The last three sentences in the selected segment. The sentence farthest from the prerequisite match is considered the last sentence. 3. {"from":1,"to":-1}: All sentences before the prerequisite match. 4. {"from":0,"to":2}: The prerequisite match sentence plus the next two sentences spoken by the specified role. This is valid only if the current and prerequisite conditions apply to the same role.<br>5. These are only examples. You can use any positive or negative integers. Positive numbers count forward from the start of the segment, and negative numbers count backward from the end.<br>

**Around the prerequisite match (anchor.location = AROUND)**

![](https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1OIkUlsKfxu4jSZPfXXb3dXXa-1482-660.png)

1\. {"from":0,"to":0}: Only the prerequisite match sentence. 2. {"from":1,"to":3}: The first to third sentences after the prerequisite match. 3. {"from":-2,"to":-4}: The second to fourth sentences before the prerequisite match. 4. {"from":-3,"to":3}: From the third sentence before the prerequisite match to the third sentence after it. 5. These are only examples. You can use any positive or negative integers. Positive numbers refer to sentences after the prerequisite match, and negative numbers refer to sentences before it.

**After the prerequisite match (anchor.location = AFTER)**

![](https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1S0eZJYj1gK0jSZFuXXcrHpXa-1490-648.png)

1\. {"from":1,"to":3}: The first three sentences in the selected segment. The sentence immediately after the prerequisite match is considered sentence 1. 2. {"from":-1,"to":-3}: The last three sentences in the selected segment. The sentence farthest from the prerequisite match is considered the last sentence. 3. {"from":1,"to":-1}: All sentences after the prerequisite match. 4. {"from":0,"to":2}: The prerequisite match sentence plus the next two sentences spoken by the specified role. This is valid only if the current and prerequisite conditions apply to the same role.<br>5. These are only examples. You can use any positive or negative integers. Positive numbers count forward from the start of the segment, and negative numbers count backward from the end.<br>
